targetYaml:
version: 1
kind: target
name: lab1
core:
    amf: ${LAB_AMF}
    plmn:
        mcc: "208"
        mnc: "93"
    slices:
        - sst: 1
          sd: "010203"
subscribers:
    - name: main
      first_supi: "208930100007500"
      count: 10
      ki: ${ORBIT_KI}
      opc: ${ORBIT_OPC}
ran:
    n2_source_ips:
        - 127.0.0.1
        - 127.0.0.2
    n3_ips:
        - 127.0.0.1
    gnb_ids:
        first: 7
        bits: 24
runYaml:
# The conformance suite against the target's core, every category, gated
# on no FAIL outside the expected-failures list and no ERROR.
kind: run
workloads:
  - name: conformance
    conformance: {categories: [negative-ie], per_test_timeout_ms: 3000}
gates:
  - name: conformance
    conformance: true
